hooks.name: Verify Evidence
hooks.description: Run the Layer-2 execution gate in order and write full output to .kiro/evidence/<spec>/<task>.log. If any step fails, mark the task NOT complete.

action.prompt: Run the Layer-2 execution gate in order (npm ci → tsc --noEmit → lint → unit+property tests → cdk synth --all + CDK Nag → module integration tests). Write full output to .kiro/evidence/<spec>/<task>.log. If any step fails, mark the task NOT complete, report the verbatim failure, and stop. Do not summarize failures as partial successes.
